name: Couple Interactions
description: Everyday cooperation and contact between two adults, A and B. Entries give each person's support and hand placement without assigning gender or a relationship.
entries: A and B standing on opposite sides of a window, A inside and B outside, raising open palms toward each other through the glass.
A holding a measuring tape against a wall while B marks its upper end with a pencil.
A and B seated across a game board, A moving a piece while B watches with hands resting beside the board.
A holding a bicycle upright by its handlebars while B crouches beside a wheel to inspect it.
A and B stretching a cloth between them, each gripping two corners with arms apart.
A seated with their back toward B, who stands behind A and gathers A's hair with both hands.
A and B seated on opposite ends of a bench, turning toward each other with their feet on the ground.
A holding a ladder steady at its base while B stands on a low rung, keeping one hand on the rail.
A and B standing back-to-back with their shoulders lightly touching, each looking ahead in the opposite direction and supporting their own weight.
B standing behind A with arms loosely around A's waist, both facing the same direction and standing on their own feet.
A and B facing each other with foreheads gently touching, their feet planted apart enough to lean forward without losing balance.
Handshake: A and B standing face-to-face at arm's length, each clasping the other's right hand with their own right hand between them.
High five: A and B facing each other with one arm raised each, their open palms meeting above shoulder level.
A seated while B stands beside A, leaning slightly toward the same open page and pointing to a detail on it.
A and B standing on opposite sides of a large box, each gripping their own side with both hands and bending their knees to share its weight.
A standing on a lower step and reaching up to B, who braces on the upper step and offers a hand without lifting A off their feet.
A and B seated side by side, A holding an open map across their lap while B points to a place on it.
A holding a small object out on an open palm while B reaches toward it, their hands separated enough to show the exchange.
A and B kneeling on opposite sides of a shared workpiece, A holding it steady while B works on its near edge.
A and B walking side by side in the same direction, A turning their head toward B while both keep space for their strides.
